name: OneLake shortcuts
short_description: Pointers in Microsoft Fabric's OneLake that reference data stored elsewhere, inside Fabric or in external storage, without copying it. The data stays at the target path while the shortcut appears in a lakehouse or other item.

evidence.quote: A shortcut is just a pointer. It's an object that says the real data is over there
A shortcut is a pointer, not a copy.
when should you use a shortcut instead of a physical copying data.
So this is where shortcuts come in. A shortcut is a virtual pointer.
A shortcut is a virtual pointer to data that lives somewhere else.
